engine.notes: Seattle keeps two forty-year institutions, Unexpected Productions in the Market and Jet City in the U District, with Bandit and the Fremont ComedySportz house behind them. Bellevue has no improv theatre of its own but Jet City teaches there; Tacoma's only improv classes come from Bandit, and the Pocket Theater's site now returns an error.

entries.name: Unexpected Productions
entries.summary: Seattle's original improv company, founded 1983, performing in its own Market Theater on Post Alley five nights a week, with Theatresports every Friday and Saturday, and improv classes in Seattle and Issaquah plus a teen programme.
entries.schedule: Shows Wednesday to Sunday; Theatresports Fridays and Saturdays 9:30pm; classes by quarter
signals: Own theatre in Pike Place Market
entries.reasons: Forty-three years, a theatre of its own in the Market, five show nights and quarterly classes on two sides of the lake; the site publishes schedules by quarter rather than by date.

entries.name: Jet City Improv
entries.area: University District and Fremont; classes also in Bellevue
entries.summary: A Seattle improv institution since 1992, now playing the Drama Room on University Way and West of Lenin in Fremont, with a curriculum from 101 to 302, weekly drop-in jams and more than a dozen recurring shows.
entries.schedule: Fall classes start the week of September 20; weekly drop-in jams year-round; shows most weekends
signals: Weekly drop-in jams with a punchcard
More than a dozen recurring show formats
entries.reasons: Three decades, a deep class ladder, weekly jams and a crowded show calendar, docked only for performing in rented rooms since losing its own theatre.

entries.name: Bandit Theater
entries.area: Central District; classes at Seattle Center and in Tacoma
entries.summary: Seattle's newest improv theatre, playing Seattle Open Arts Place on 18th Avenue Thursday and Friday nights, with a four-level improv track taught at Theatre Puget Sound, sketch and stand-up programmes, a BIPOC cohort and classes in Tacoma.
entries.schedule: Shows Thursdays and Fridays at 7, 8:15 and 9:15pm; fall 2026 classes enrolling; BIPOC cohorts November 8 to December 16
signals: Four improv levels, eight weeks each
entries.reasons: A full class ladder, two show nights and the only improv classes reaching Tacoma, limited by its youth and rented stages.

entries.name: Seattle Comedy Theater (ComedySportz Seattle)
entries.summary: Fremont's longest-running improv community and home of ComedySportz Seattle for over a decade at the Atlas Theater, with the ComedySportz match, improvised Shakespeare, an all-ages matinee, classes beginner to advanced and a Rec League.
entries.schedule: ComedySportz matches on weekends; classes from beginner workshops to advanced training
signals: ComedySportz franchise, over a decade in Fremont
Theatre of its own at 3509 Fremont Ave N
entries.reasons: A permanent theatre and a known format, but the site leaves class dates and show nights to its ticketing calendar.

entries.name: Taproot Theatre Acting Studio
entries.summary: The acting studio of Taproot Theatre in Greenwood runs an introduction-to-improv course for adults each session in the theatre's cafe space, and sends a touring improv company to schools and events.
entries.schedule: Improv for Adults, fall session September 28 to December 14, 2026
signals: Adult intro improv course each session
entries.reasons: A permanent theatre and a dated adult class, but a single beginner course and no public improv shows at home.

entries.name: Freehold Theatre
entries.summary: A long-standing actor-training studio on Maynard Avenue whose quarterly catalogue includes Improv, Intermediate Improv and Improv for Writers alongside acting, voice and movement classes.
entries.schedule: Fall quarter classes open; improv offerings vary by quarter
signals: Improv, Intermediate Improv and Improv for Writers
entries.reasons: A respected studio with two improv levels in its catalogue, but no shows and no guarantee which classes run each quarter.
